findings.quote: Θεωρούμε ότι ένας μήνας αποτελείται από 4 εβδομάδες.
findings.explanation: Neither the English nor the Greek problem defines a month as four weeks. Calendar months have more than 28 days, and no particular month is specified, so 200 hours is not uniquely implied. The arithmetic is correct only under the explicitly introduced but unsupported four-week convention inherited from the reference.
findings.suggested_action: Record the answer as conditional on a four-week-month convention, or clarify the problem statement to define one month as four weeks. Because this is audit-only, do not alter the candidate here.

verification_needed: Evidence of a dataset-wide convention that one month means exactly four weeks, or clarification of the intended month length.
